description: Keep Your Family Safe with mLite! mLite is a trusted parental control and family safety app designed to help parents protect their children while maintaining open communication and transparency. With advanced location-sharing features and safety tools, mLite helps families stay connected and informed while respecting privacy and consent. Key Features of mLite 🌏 Live Location Sharing Use mLite as a geolocator and GPS phone tracker to view your child’s location in real time. The app makes location sharing between family members simple, helping parents stay informed about their child’s whereabouts. 👪 Family GPS Locator mLite works as a reliable family GPS locator, allowing parents to check family members' locations whenever needed. Whether you're trying to find kids after school or stay connected during travel, mLite provides accurate and up-to-date location information. 🧒 Child Location Tracker The built-in child location tracker helps parents monitor their child's location and movement patterns. Real-time updates make it easier to ensure children are safe throughout the day. 📍 Geofencing Alerts Create safe zones such as home, school, or other important locations and receive notifications when your child enters or leaves these areas. This feature supports family safety while respecting personal privacy. 📝 Location History Review previously visited locations to better understand your child's daily routine and help ensure they spend time in safe environments. 🆘 Emergency SOS Button If your child is in danger or needs help, they can send an instant alert with their current location so you can respond quickly. 🔎 Contact List Review With the required permissions and consent, parents can review contact lists to help ensure children communicate with trusted individuals. 📩 Safe Communication Monitoring As part of mLite's parental control functionality, parents can monitor certain communications with the child's knowledge and consent to promote safer online interactions. Note: Some features may be limited or unavailable on iPhones. Privacy and Compliance mLite is intended exclusively for lawful family use with the consent of all involved users. The app cannot be used without the child’s knowledge and complies with GDPR, Google Play policies, and applicable data protection regulations. We do not collect, share, or sell personal information without appropriate authorization. All monitoring and location features are designed solely to support child protection and family safety. mLite uses Accessibility Services only for parental control and child safety purposes. These services help parents monitor certain app activities and receive safety-related alerts. Accessibility Services are not used to record calls, modify device settings without permission, bypass Android privacy protections, or access personal information beyond the app’s stated functionality. Getting Started 1. Install mLite on the parent’s and child’s devices. 2. Create a parent account. 3. Select “Child” during setup on the child’s device. 4. Enable location and contact permissions. 5. Connect devices using a QR code or family link. 6. Start using the locator app to monitor locations and improve family safety. Required Permissions * Camera & Photos: To connect devices via QR code scanning. * Contacts: To support safe family communication features. * Location Data: To power the GPS phone tracker, child location tracker, family GPS locator, geofencing alerts, and real-time location sharing. Privacy Policy: https://mliteapp.com/privacy.html Terms of Use: https://mliteapp.com/terms-of-use/ Questions? Contact us at support@mliteapp.com
